# Search plugins shipped with qBittorrentAccess

Installed once in the user's search engines at first start (Tools/plugins_test.py checked each one returns results).
Each plugin belongs to its author; source of each file:

- academictorrents.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LightDestory/qBittorrent-Search-Plugins/master/src/engines/academictorrents.py
- acgrip.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nishizhen/qBit-search-plugins/main/acgrip.py
- animetosho.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlaaBrahim/qBitTorrent-animetosho-search-plugin/main/animetosho.py
- eztvx.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DrPurp/eztvx-qbittorrent-plugin/main/eztvx.py
- limetorrents.py: https://github.com/qbittorrent/search-plugins/tree/master/nova3/engines (official qBittorrent plugins)
- nyaasi.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MadeOfMagicAndWires/qBit-plugins/master/engines/nyaasi.py
- piratebay.py: https://github.com/qbittorrent/search-plugins/tree/master/nova3/engines (official qBittorrent plugins)
- pirateiro.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LightDestory/qBittorrent-Search-Plugins/master/src/engines/pirateiro.py
- rutor.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imDMG/qBt_SE/master/engines/rutor.py
- sktorrent.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ashalda/sktorrent-qbt/refs/heads/main/sktorrent.py
- torlock.py: https://github.com/qbittorrent/search-plugins/tree/master/nova3/engines (official qBittorrent plugins)
- torrentdownload.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LightDestory/qBittorrent-Search-Plugins/master/src/engines/torrentdownload.py
- torrentdownloads.py: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BurningMop/qBittorrent-Search-Plugins/refs/heads/main/torrentdownloads.py
- torrentscsv.py: https://github.com/qbittorrent/search-plugins/tree/master/nova3/engines (official qBittorrent plugins)
- yts.py: https://codeberg.org/lazulyra/qbit-plugins/raw/branch/main/yts/yts.py
